query: SELECT streamer_login AS "streamer_login!", stream_title AS "stream_title!", avg_viewers::float8 AS "avg_viewers!", followers_start::int8 AS "followers_start!" FROM twitch_stream_sessions WHERE started_at >= $1 AND streamer_login IS NOT NULL AND streamer_login != '' AND stream_title IS NOT NULL AND stream_title != '' AND avg_viewers IS NOT NULL AND followers_start IS NOT NULL AND followers_start > 0
